new_today_news.headline: Restaurant cooking oil theft is on the rise, Beverly police say — here's why
new_today_news.summary: Used cooking oil theft from restaurants is increasing as thieves sell it on the black market for recycling into reusable fuel. Security video captured multiple thefts from Beverly, Massachusetts restaurants, highlighting the value of used cooking oil as it can be turned into expensive biodiesel.

new_today_news.headline: Weirton Wastewater Treatment Plant Expansion Continues Toward Finish Line
new_today_news.summary: $38 million project expanding Weirton's WWTP capacity from 4 to 8 million gallons per day reached substantial completion in April 2026. Remaining work includes touch-up, aeration basin tasks, and warranty-related items.

new_today_news.headline: Fredericksburg, VA Takes on Pizza Box Recycling
new_today_news.summary: A study confirmed that pizza boxes are recyclable by paper mills. Grease and cheese in amounts typically found on pizza boxes are not an issue for the recycling process.

new_today_news.headline: Cortland County DPW Potentially Won't Have Plow Drivers After 5 p.m. This Winter
new_today_news.summary: Cortland County's Department of Public Works reports being down 14 CDL drivers, requiring 14 more to reach full staffing of 28 drivers. County has approved a $7,500 CDL driver stipend to address workforce shortages.

recent_news.headline: Barrel Energy Plans October Launch of Almighty Cleaners Eco-Friendly Degreaser Line
recent_news.summary: Barrel Energy plans to launch Almighty Cleaners, an eco-friendly cleaners and degreasers line in October 2026, extending its Happy Traps grease-trap waste collection unit into branded product sales. Recovered cooking oil and grease-trap waste will serve as feedstock, providing cost and sourcing advantages in sustainability-focused markets.

recent_news.headline: RTI's Impact Report Reflects on Growth, Innovation, and Measurable Sustainability in the Food Service Industry
recent_news.summary: Restaurant Technologies (RTI) released its 2026 Impact Report highlighting 393 million pounds of used cooking oil (UCO) recycled in 2025, alongside delivery of 719.4 million pounds of fresh cooking oil. The report showcases improved fleet efficiency, new sustainability certifications, and expanded opportunities to convert UCO into renewable fuels, while eliminating 19.3 million plastic oil jugs.

recent_news.headline: This Week in Waste: Top Stories Oct 5 – Oct 9
recent_news.summary: Weekly waste industry roundup covering October 5-9, 2026. Casella Waste Systems announced its landfill in Bethlehem will close by end of 2026, a year earlier than planned.
